# Native third-party

## WebView2 (DeskNote WYSIWYG)

Slim extract used by the build:

- `webview2-include/` — `WebView2.h`, `WebView2EnvironmentOptions.h`
- `webview2-x64/` — `WebView2LoaderStatic.lib` (+ optional DLL)

Full NuGet package (optional cache) may live under `Microsoft.Web.WebView2/`.
Refresh from: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Web.WebView2
